name: Vampiric Experiments
source:
He called it progress. A serum that froze aging, and a plan to stop time completely. In his mind, it worked...

[From [url=https://reachfordastarz.itch.io/vampiric-experiments]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他将此称为“进步”——一剂冻结衰老的血清，外加一项令时间彻底静止的宏伟计划。至少在他自己看来，实验成功了……

[摘自[url=https://reachfordastarz.itch.io/vampiric-experiments]itch.io[/url]]
